items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know who said something very similar was Ray Conniff. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah?

ctx.x: really reach. And as a result of it I didn’t realize that the true gift was not writing the notes on the paper, it was coming up with the idea. And for some reason instinctively I was gifted to come up with ideas. Like The Four Seasons – we needed an intro and there was scuffling. So I go to the piano on “Candy Girl” and I played this. I played four chords and I says, “How’s this?” They said, “What did you do?” And the take “Dawn (Go Away),” which was written as a folk song and make it sound like it was an…
You know who said something very similar was Ray Conniff.
